messages:
Alyssa: Heads-up — our KB shortlink redirect sweep flagged a bunch of 404s for /kb/s/ links. Saw at least 7 hits in the last 24h. Example: https://kb.redwood.ai/s/s-PK7 -> 404. Anyone own the shortlink mapping table?

doc-scanner-bot: [Alert] shortlink-scan: 7 broken shortlinks found in /kb redirects. Report: https://internal/reports/scan/2307711123

Ben: I can do quick triage — can someone paste a sample failing doc? I can patch frontmatter or add a redirect.

Alyssa: here’s one: https://kb.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/fast-batching (path responds 200 but the shortlink 404s). suspect shortlink DB got out of sync after yesterday's import. cc @Matt

Matt: that's mine — I own runtime docs. I didn't touch shortlink export. I'll take a look.

Sana: If it's a migration hiccup we should have a quick roll-forward plan. Is there an easy sed replace to fix common broken shortlink pattern? Or do we need to rebuild mapping?

Ben: for a quick fix, add a redirect entry in redirects.yaml for the specific shortlinks. e.g.:

```yaml
- from: /s/s-PK7
  to: /docs/runtime/fast-batching
  status: 301
```

I'll open a PR in kb-configs.

Ben: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kb-configs/pull/482 — small redirects + test. Diff:

```diff
+ - from: /s/s-PK7
+   to: /docs/runtime/fast-batching
+   status: 301
```

Please review, @Matt @Alyssa.

Matt: Looking. One question: we should normalize all /s/ IDs into 8-char tokens. I can add a tiny script to regenerate mapping from canonical table — will follow up.

Alyssa: thanks. Can we get this merged and deployed before EOD? Also, @docs-team if anyone else is seeing random 404s please drop examples here.

doc-scanner-bot: scan-complete: after applying PR checks, I still see 3 shortlink 404s that don't have a clear mapping. Files: s-X3D4, s-99ZQ, s-AB12. Tagging owners by heuristics.

Ben: I'll add placeholders for those 3 with redirect to /docs/search-results?q=shortlink so users land on relevant search while we trace origins.

Sana: Also file an incident ticket so we have a trail: JIRA-ENG-8812. I'll add postmortem checklist.

Alyssa: :thumbsup: thanks. Matt — once you regenerate mapping, can you drop the script in infra/kb/tools and link the run command so ops can re-run if needed?

Matt: yep. I'll push the script and instructions. ETA tomorrow morning.

Ben: merged PR and deployed to staging — https://staging-kb.redwood.ai/s/s-PK7 now 301 -> /docs/runtime/fast-batching. Will roll to prod after smoke test.

Alyssa: closing loop — schedule quick sweep tomorrow 09:30 PT? I'll send calendar invite.

Ben: noted, will run quick automated shortlink smoke post-deploy and post results here.
